description: Verify HITL1 user input has been recorded to rb_profile.yaml: research_profile selected, root_must_answer_set non-empty, hitl1 status marker written.

rules.failure_message: rb_profile.yaml does not exist. The bundle may not have been instantiated.
rb_profile.yaml exists but fails ProfileSchema validation. Check inspect output for specific field errors.
research_profile is still 'not_selected'. The user must choose a research profile (quick_factual, exploratory_map, or claim_verification) during HITL1.
root_must_answer_set is empty. The user must specify at least one must-answer question during HITL1.
hitl1.status is not 'recorded'. After collecting user answers, set status to 'recorded'.
hitl1.recorded_at is missing or empty. Write the ISO 8601 timestamp when HITL1 was recorded.
rb_status.json current_gate must be 'hitl1_recorded'. Use advance-status --to hitl1_recorded to advance.
rb_status.json next_gate must be 'setup_ready'. Use advance-status --to hitl1_recorded to set the correct next_gate.
